guide_probe.child_set_source: Actual native saved persistent pile_guide_index values; no fixed-size grouping assumption
guide_probe.scope: One independent saved guide/control, edited and restored in memory; no disk save or render.

measured_arc_length.scope: Uniform Catmull-Rom integration with duplicated endpoints on actual float32 controls. Official Restore constrains control-segment lengths; no v3 arc-length preservation or physical simulation is asserted.
measured_arc_length.nominal_budget_limit: Every saved rest curve is measured against the nominal 0.70 budget; evaluated GN Catmull-Rom arc lengths are reported separately and are not assumed to preserve that budget.
